name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Digital & Web Strategy Leader — Analytics, CRO, and Cross-Functional Execution
summary: Digital and web strategy leader whose portfolio work at Wix contributed to a 30% increase in website traffic and a 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment. 15+ years across MarTech, SaaS, and B2B agency environments owning site architecture and SEO, GA4 measurement, landing page and conversion optimization, and the reporting that proves impact. Runs digital programs end to end: strategy, cross-functional stakeholder alignment, project execution, and continuous test-and-learn optimization.

Track acquisition and conversion across multiple accounts in GA4 and CRM analytics, delivering reporting that drives experimentation and growth.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, and present the insights to executive stakeholders.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account, cutting spam and low-quality leads and improving click-through quality, then diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck.
Draft direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages that drive engagement and pipeline.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks that monitor automated outputs and continuously optimize conversion rates.
Architected and deployed a complete marketing-automation system of 20+ workflows spanning lead capture, tagging and routing, qualification, booking, no-show recovery, and reactivation.

Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.
